integrity: Finite exhaustive self-review, no independent audit, uncertainty about unindexed duplicate results.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the 24-vertex McGee graph at nine and ten independent-set tokens only; computation is exhaustive with reproducible scripts and does not establish a general cage theorem. The independence-set size vector is already published and is not claimed as novel.
title: The maximum-packing reconfiguration transition in the McGee graph
